From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NexaHealth redlines — legal analysis and recommended path

Team,

I reviewed Nexa’s redlines (attached) and summarized the material risks. Key points:
- Liability cap: request to move to $2M is above our standard $1M cap and outside delegated legal authority. Accepting would increase our exposure materially.
- Warranty carve: removing throughput limitation for patient-identifying metadata effectively expands warranty to cover performance across all data types — this is a commercial change with potential cost/engineering impact.
- Indemnity: their requested mutual indemnity for data breaches is reasonable in principle, but they are asking for unlimited indemnity for third-party claims tied to certain regulatory fines; must be limited and reciprocal.

Recommendation: escalate to exec for approval with specific tradeoffs: (1) increase liability cap to no more than $1.75M for this pilot only, (2) convert warranty carve to a defined 90-day warranty for data processing reliability with performance SLAs and agreed remediation steps, and (3) mutual indemnity with regulatory fines limited to proven gross negligence and a dollar cap aligned with the liability cap. Require SOC 2 type II evidence within 45 days as a condition.

I’ve attached Redline_Summary_Marissa_v1.pdf with proposed language. This request requires an approval from someone with commercial delegation (VP Sales / CRO) — tagging Aditya for decision.

Marissa
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redline_Summary_Marissa_v1.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NexaHealth redlines — commercial compromise proposal

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Commercial perspective: Nexa is strategic in healthcare vertical and pilot could expand quickly if successful. Proposed commercial compromise to propose to Nexa:
- Liability cap: $1.75M (pilot-only exception)
- Warranty: 90-day limited warranty on data processing with a performance SLA and remediation plan
- Indemnity: mutual indemnity, regulatory fines limited to gross negligence and capped by the liability cap
- Price concession: 12% one-time pilot discount in exchange for 24-month commit to conversion and customer reference

This is an exception to standard terms — I can approve the commercial side conditionally but need legal to draft the exact language and finance to confirm the discount within our GP thresholds. Jonas — can finance support 12% for this deal if we get a 24-month commitment? If yes, I’ll signoff as CRO for this one-time exception.

Aditya
VP Sales / CRO — Redwood Inference
